inputs: Require the checked Python verification projection, registered source graph and native plan. Explicit Python executable and existing real temporary parent are normalized absolute paths; no interpreter search, dependency installation or implicit source replacement.
replay: Verify exact source currentness, copy only the bounded source manifest into a fresh private workspace and reconstruct the same plan there. Write generated artifacts once. Do not copy repositories, dependencies or full plans per node.
native: A compiler-bundled independent Python AST observer compiles every module in memory, compares binding/import syntax against the selected inventory, and imports every module from its exact generated file. Use isolated no-site no-bytecode execution, a clean environment, bounded output and a deadline. Module observation is not a proof of native domain form or behavior.
currentness: Pin the resolved interpreter bytes and observe loaded standard-library file hashes. Recheck executable, observed tool files, complete private source/artifact inventory and source manifest after execution. Any observed failure remains failed; dependent successes cannot survive a final currentness failure.
cleanup: Remove only the exact owned private workspace in a finally boundary after the subprocess terminates. Cleanup failure is evidence failure, never success or silent residue. Reject symlink/nonregular source and artifact paths; this is not an operating-system sandbox or a hostile concurrent-host guarantee.
report: Retain every required projection check. Only checks actually performed can pass. Semantic behavior, cross-generator behavior, source-to-native formal preservation and Lean execution remain not-evaluable until their own executors run. The native-stage result and incomplete whole-verification result are distinct.
effects: Explicit verification starts a local Python process and imports compiler-generated modules in one temporary workspace. It does not call domain Operations/providers, publish product output, change defaults, admit or release anything. Existing published output currentness may be checked read-only when explicitly selected.
remaining: Connect independent per-metatype native-form/semantic observers, positive/negative and compiling-mutant behavior, shared formal execution and final public verify-project integration. All R10-R18 denominators remain unchanged.
